$comment: EOS Ownership Model v1 — the sandbox physical-root operating-company assignments.
ASSIGNED by Owner ruling R-1 (2026-08-30). These are AUTHORED certification-world facts.
THEY ARE NOT INFERRED, AND NO CODE MAY EVER INFER THEM. There is no 'north means Ventana'
function, no 'truck 04 and above means Ventana', no 'main means Taylor', and there must not be.
The ids simply map to company ids in this file. If a rule appears to exist in the data below, it
is a coincidence of authoring order and must not be implemented.
WHY THE SPLIT. The certification world needs BOTH operating companies present across stationary
inventory, mobile inventory, same-company transactions and cross-company transactions. A
Taylor-only sandbox could not certify the ownership model at all: every transfer would be
same-company and the cross-company path would never execute once.
MEASURED CORRECTION TO THE FIRST PLAN. It listed four root families and 19 records. The
referential derivation check found two of them are not roots:
- stock_locations is a per-warehouse-per-part BALANCE record, not a place. 5/5 derive from
- trucks carry homeWarehouseId. 2/2 derive from their home warehouse.
Only warehouses and mobile_locations are primary: 12 decisions, not 19.
APPLYING THESE TO LIVE SANDBOX RECORDS IS A SEPARATE AUTHORIZATION. This file is the decision.
